Change fields of an existing entry. Fields that you omit stay as they are. `id` is the full id or the last 8 characters.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | `string` | yes | Full id or the last 8 characters of the entry. |
| `summary` | `string` | no | One line, max 120 characters. Put longer text in `details`. |
| `details` | `string` | no | New longer text for the entry. |
| `kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | no | New kind: done, blocker, or next. |
| `project` | `string` | no | New project name. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | New tags. They replace the current tags. |
| `refs` | `object[]` | no | New references. They replace the current references. |
| `refs.type` | `"pr" \| "jira" \| "commit" \| "url"` | yes |  |
| `refs.value` | `string` | yes |  |
| `refs.repo` | `string` | no |  |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry result](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-result).
